result: KB3d set-level verdict: the two remaining rows (5,1),(6,0) of the (11,6)/(6,11) family of PR 2542's 17-point cover question are impossible; the whole (11,6)/(6,11) family is excluded, and with PR 2542 and PR 2773 no 17-point set covers F2^7 (set level, no words enumerated).

labels.statement: For A in the even coset and B in the odd coset of F2^7 with |A| = 11, |B| = 6 (either order), the 66 cross sums cannot cover all 64 odd masks: with rho = r - 1_O (r = 1_A * 1_B) of total 2, the even-cardinality side's characters are {0, +2, -2} off {0, all-ones}, but Parseval gives a remainder of 696 over 126 squares of at most 4 (696 > 504, deficit 192).
labels.label: PROVEN
labels.evidence: fourier17.obstruction (exact integer arithmetic), test_engine.py 13 tests, independent.py second path (FWHT + Parseval double counting + exhaustive rho-hat control over all 2,080 total-2 shapes + exhaustive F2^3 identity over 65,536 set pairs).

labels.statement: Rows (5,1) and (6,0) of the (11,6)/(6,11) family (the whole recorded remainder of PR 2773, pair-sum excess 5 and 6 at 11 points, shared = 1, c = 1) are impossible; hence no 17-point set of split (11,6)/(6,11) covers F2^7 and at L = 22 every universal word needs at least 18 distinct prefixes.
labels.label: PROVEN
labels.evidence: The obstruction above covers every row of the family (it does not use the even half of the covering condition); the remainder rows themselves are reproduced from the vendored PR 2773 row engine (sharp_rows(7,11,6) filtered by the recorded k=11 floor e_ex >= 5 gives exactly (5,1),(6,0)).

labels.statement: The literal claim 'No 17-point set covers F2^7' is complete at the set level.
labels.label: PROVEN
labels.evidence: Jointly with PR 2542 ((9,8)/(8,9) dead in the pair-representation identity) and PR 2773 ((10,7)/(7,10) excluded exactly against the census floor; (3,3),(4,2) demoted by the completed k=11 census), plus this package's exclusion of (5,1),(6,0) and therefore of the whole (11,6)/(6,11) family. All six counting-feasible splits are now excluded.

labels.statement: The recorded predecessor anchors of PR 2542/2634/2773 are reproduced (REPRO tiers 945/31, 10395/49, 945945/59; length-18 census 15,775,992 nodes / 312,064 cycles / 0 universal; row table; n=5 set controls; the four zero shards recomputed against the PR 2773 receipt; and the two heavy anchors recomputed in full: PASS_ANCHORS_K10B3 count=149990400, PASS_ANCHORS_K11B4 count=0).
